AI-Birthday product: local-first Android birthday manager with user-reviewed AI/manual messages
Flutter application (Dart): Riverpod state, go_router navigation, Drift SQLite
Android native layer (Kotlin): notifications/alarms, Gemini Nano bridge, gated SMS adapter
Firebase Functions control plane and purchase/deletion callables (TypeScript, region asia-south1)
Public Hosting site (Vite/TypeScript): privacy, terms, support, account deletion
Distribution flavors play and personal (Gradle flavor dimension distribution)
Owner-scoped Firestore rules with deletion fence (presence DELETING or tombstone) and server-only collections
App Check enforced with token consumption on every callable
Recent Google reauthentication gate for destructive callables
Strict Zod request schemas reject unknown fields
Secrets (Gemini key, tokens) in secure storage, never in job payloads, backups or logs
Entitlement-first AI gate before any provider is selected
Capability gates default-off for automatic SMS and automatic preparation
Purchase verification with account binding, ownership claim, and deletion fence
Hosting Content-Security-Policy headers (apis.google.com allowed for popup sign-in; browser test not run)
Global Flutter/Platform error handlers route to the app logger without message text
App Check is not attached to Firestore REST backup/restore or Identity Toolkit calls (A3-004)
Cloud backup is plaintext owner-scoped Firestore data, not end-to-end encrypted
GitHub Actions CI: Flutter analyze/tests/goldens, release APK builds, backend and hosting checks, Play permission guard
Firebase project config: Hosting headers/rewrites, Firestore rules, indexes, TTL policies
Hosting release-config generation tool
Gradle Android build with play and personal flavors
Drift code generation (build_runner) for app_database.g.dart
